## Intro

Most single cell ATAC data has no RNA next to it: Cell Ranger ATAC runs, or
public fragment files. This vignette starts from a fragment file alone: cells
called from the fragment counts, QC and multiplets, peaks per cluster, TF-IDF
and LSI, clusters and differential accessibility, then gene activity and
labels transferred from an RNA reference.

The fragments are the ATAC half of the 10x PBMC 3k multiome used in the
[multiome vignette](https://gregorlueg.github.io/bixverse/articles/atac_multiome.html).
That has a use here: its RNA half is a reference built from the very same
nuclei, so we can check the transferred labels against the RNA clusters of
each cell, which a real ATAC-only data set cannot offer.

An ATAC-only experiment is a `SingleCellsAtac`: its own store holds the peaks
or tiles, and the ATAC functions take it exactly as they take the ATAC side of
a `SingleCellsMultiModal`. `modality = "atac"` and the default both name its
store.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(bixverse)
library(bixverse.plots)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
```

```{r}
#| label: paths
data_dir <- download_pbmc_multiome()
fragments <- file.path(data_dir, "pbmc_unsorted_3k_atac_fragments.tsv.gz")
gtf <- file.path(data_dir, "gencode.v32.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
blacklist <- file.path(data_dir, "hg38-blacklist.v2.bed.gz")
cr_peaks <- file.path(data_dir, "pbmc_unsorted_3k_atac_peaks.bed")
h5_path <- file.path(data_dir, "pbmc_unsorted_3k_filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")

new_dir <- function(name) {
  path <- file.path(tempdir(), name)
  dir.create(path, showWarnings = FALSE)
  path
}
```

## Calling cells

Without a barcode list the cells come from the fragment counts: real cells
carry thousands of fragments, empty droplets a handful. The knee plot of
fragments per barcode, sorted, shows where the two meet. With Cell Ranger
ATAC output, `cellranger = "singlecell.csv"` takes its calls instead.

```{r}
#| label: knee plot
counts <- barcode_fragment_counts(fragments)
counts[, rank := seq_len(.N)]

ggplot(counts, aes(x = rank, y = n_fragments)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 3000, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(x = "Barcode rank", y = "Fragments") +
  theme_bx()
```

The knee sits near 3,000 fragments. We call cells there and count them into
the peaks Cell Ranger called on all cells pooled, which every Cell Ranger ATAC
run ships. They are good enough to cluster on; better peaks come from the
clusters below.

```{r}
#| label: first load
first <- load_atac_fragments(
  SingleCellsAtac(dir_data = new_dir("atac_first")),
  fragments = fragments,
  peaks = cr_peaks,
  min_fragments = 3000L,
  .verbose = FALSE
)

first
```

## Quality control

The same metrics as with RNA next to it: fragments, nucleosome signal, TSS
enrichment, and AMULET's multiplet calls, which need nothing but the
fragments.

```{r}
#| label: qc
first <- fragment_qc_sc(first, fragments = fragments, gtf = gtf)
first <- amulet_sc(first, fragments = fragments, restrict_beds = blacklist)
```

```{r}
#| label: fragment profiles
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 3.6
#| eval: !expr utils::packageVersion("bixverse.plots") >= "0.4.0"
profiles <- fragment_profiles_sc(first, fragments = fragments, gtf = gtf)

tss_profile_plot_sc(profiles$tss) + fragment_length_plot_sc(profiles$lengths)
```

```{r}
#| label: filter
obs <- first[[c(
  "cell_id",
  "atac_n_fragments",
  "atac_nucleosome_signal",
  "atac_tss_enrichment",
  "amulet_multiplet"
)]]
keep <- obs$atac_nucleosome_signal < 2 &
  obs$atac_tss_enrichment > 2 &
  !obs$amulet_multiplet
sprintf("keeping %i of %i cells", sum(keep), nrow(obs))

first <- set_cells_to_keep(first, obs$cell_id[keep])
```

## First clusters

TF-IDF, LSI and Leiden on Cell Ranger's peaks give the clusters to call peaks
on.

```{r}
#| label: first clusters
first <- run_tfidf_sc(first)
first <- find_top_features_sc(first, min_cutoff = "q25")
first <- calculate_lsi_sc(
  first,
  lsi_params = params_atac_lsi(n_comp = 30L),
  .verbose = FALSE
)
first <- find_neighbours_sc(first, embd_to_use = "lsi", .verbose = FALSE)
first <- find_clusters_sc(first, res = 0.8, .verbose = FALSE)
```

## Peaks

Peaks per cluster, merged, blacklist and contigs dropped, then the fragments
counted against them into the experiment we keep, for the cells that passed
QC.

```{r}
#| label: peaks
peaks <- call_peaks_sc(
  first,
  fragments = fragments,
  group_by = "leiden_clustering"
)
peaks <- peaks[grepl("^chr[0-9XY]+$", chrom)]
peaks <- remove_blacklisted(peaks, blacklist)

atac <- load_atac_fragments(
  SingleCellsAtac(dir_data = new_dir("atac_peaks")),
  fragments = fragments,
  peaks = peaks,
  barcodes = get_cell_names(first, filtered = TRUE),
  .verbose = FALSE
)
atac <- fragment_qc_sc(atac, fragments = fragments, gtf = gtf)
atac <- annotate_peaks_sc(atac, gtf = gtf)

atac
```

## TF-IDF, LSI, clusters

```{r}
#| label: lsi
atac <- run_tfidf_sc(atac)
atac <- find_top_features_sc(atac, min_cutoff = "q25")
atac <- calculate_lsi_sc(atac, .verbose = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: lsi depth correlation
#| eval: !expr utils::packageVersion("bixverse.plots") >= "0.4.0"
lsi_depth_plot_sc(get_lsi_depth_cor(atac))
```

```{r}
#| label: clusters
atac <- find_neighbours_sc(
  atac,
  embd_to_use = "lsi",
  no_embd_to_use = 30L,
  .verbose = FALSE
)
atac <- find_clusters_sc(atac, res = 0.8, .verbose = FALSE)
atac <- umap_sc(atac, embd_to_use = "lsi", .verbose = FALSE)

embedding_plot_sc(
  atac,
  embedding = "umap",
  colour_by = "leiden_clustering",
  discrete = TRUE,
  point_size = 0.5
)
```

## Differential accessibility

On an ATAC experiment the marker functions test peaks by default, with the
logistic regression that takes the library size as covariate. As in the
multiome vignette, treat the p-values as a ranking.

```{r}
#| label: differential accessibility
da <- find_all_markers_sc(
  atac,
  column_of_interest = "leiden_clustering",
  .verbose = FALSE
)
annotation <- get_sc_var(atac, cols = c("gene_id", "closest_gene"))
setnames(annotation, "gene_id", "feature_id")
da <- merge(da, annotation, by = "feature_id", all.x = TRUE)

head(da[fdr < 0.05][order(-lfc)], 10)
```

## Labels from an RNA reference

Gene activity puts the ATAC cells in gene space, where an RNA reference can
meet them. The reference here is the RNA of the same 3k nuclei, clustered the
usual way; in practice it would be any annotated RNA data set of the tissue.

```{r}
#| label: rna reference
rna <- load_tenx_h5(
  SingleCells(dir_data = new_dir("atac_rna")),
  h5_path = h5_path,
  .verbose = FALSE
)
rna <- find_hvg_sc(rna, hvg_no = 2000L, .verbose = FALSE)
rna <- calculate_pca_sc(rna, no_pcs = 30L, .verbose = FALSE)
rna <- find_neighbours_sc(rna, .verbose = FALSE)
rna <- find_clusters_sc(
  rna,
  res = 0.8,
  name = "rna_cluster",
  .verbose = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: transfer
ga <- gene_activity_sc(atac, fragments = fragments, gtf = gtf, .verbose = FALSE)

transfer <- transfer_labels_seurat_sc(
  reference = rna,
  query = ga,
  label_column = "rna_cluster",
  weight_embedding = get_embedding(atac, "lsi"),
  .verbose = FALSE
)
```

Each ATAC cell's predicted cluster against the RNA cluster of the same
barcode:

```{r}
#| label: agreement
truth <- rna[[c("cell_id", "rna_cluster")]]
pred <- merge(
  transfer[, .(cell_id, predicted = predicted_rna_cluster)],
  truth,
  by = "cell_id"
)
sprintf(
  "%i shared cells; the transferred label is right for %.1f%%",
  nrow(pred),
  100 * mean(pred$predicted == as.character(pred$rna_cluster))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: predicted labels on the umap
umap_dt <- data.table(
  get_embedding(atac, "umap"),
  predicted = transfer$predicted_rna_cluster
)
setnames(umap_dt, 1:2, c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2"))

ggplot(umap_dt, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, colour = predicted)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_bx()
```
